cases.name: near-identical paragraphs
cases.input: Two paragraphs state the same proposition and support with only cosmetic wording changes.

cases.name: distant paraphrase
cases.input: Two paragraphs use different vocabulary but assert the same relation and add no distinct support.

cases.name: technical term with different claims
cases.input: Both paragraphs repeat the canonical construct label but one defines it and the other reports a measurement condition.

cases.name: introduction and conclusion reprise
cases.input: The conclusion restates the governing thesis while adding the warranted implication of the study.

cases.name: semantic safeguard mismatch
cases.input: One paragraph asserts causality; the other denies causality or limits the claim to an association.

cases.name: same claim with new evidence
cases.input: Both paragraphs state the same claim, but the second adds a distinct source, datum, or example.

cases.name: cut preservation packet
cases.input: A true duplicate is proposed for removal.
